# Shared paths: a change to any of these can break every app, so CI
# (.github/workflows/ci.yml, `shared` paths-filter) and `task pre-pr`
# (scripts/pre-pr-scope.sh) both select ALL apps when one matches.
# This file is the single source of truth for both.
#
# One pattern per line; blank lines and `#` comments are ignored. Only two
# forms are allowed, because both dorny/paths-filter (picomatch) and bash
# `[[ == ]]` must read them identically:
#   a literal repo-root path    e.g. uv.lock
#   a directory subtree         e.g. packages/**
pyproject.toml
uv.lock
.github/**
taskfiles/**
.pre-commit-config.yaml
REUSE.toml
Taskfile.yml
scripts/**
packages/**
